versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

xiaohongshu-hall-faq-stills v0.1.1

- Initial release: transforms Xiaohongshu hall FAQ complaints into a set of 4–8 materials stills, each based on confirmed document facts.
- Specifies precise workflow for collecting complaints, planning materials slots, and managing paid image generation or lookup steps via bundled tools.
- Mandates detailed inspection and reporting for user-supplied stills and all generated assets.
- Separates note lookup, generate, transform, and edit stages, each gated with transparent billing, identity, and explicit user approval.
- Enforces strict use of provided MCP client for all remote operations; no fallback to REST/API or host connector.
- Clarifies when and how to ask the user for missing inputs, brand preferences, and pack size, ensuring clear boundaries and no data invention.
